than what is lost, a positive nitrogen balance is achieved, reflecting a gain of total body protein. Positive nitrogen 
balance is essential for growth and healing. 
Conversely, a negative nitrogen balance reflects protein degradation, with protein loss higher than protein retention. 
A negative protein balance in acute care substantially impacts survival (Dupuis et al., 2022). Healthy adults achieve 
nitrogen balance when protein intake is the same as protein degradation. Table 2.9 lists the protein content of 
animal- and plant-based foods.
